programs.title: Luther
programs.desc:
Detective John Luther often bends the law to catch criminals, which often endangers his superiors.An uncompromising policeman returns to work after a long leave, on which he was sent due to the trauma he experienced during one of the operations.The first investigation he undertakes concerns the murder of the parents of the brilliant Alice Morgan.A policeman and the victims' daughter begin to form a unique bond.At the same time, John must deal with personal problems.He wants to repair his marriage with Zoe, which has suffered greatly because of his work
Young mother Kirsten Ross is kidnapped.Luther suspects the writer Lucien Burgess, who is fascinated by the occult.He and his partner Ripley wonder if the case can be connected to a murder that occurred ten years ago.However, they must act quickly.Meanwhile, Zoe's partner is beaten.The woman believes that Luther committed this act and files a complaint against him.However, it quickly turns out that the beating involves a much more complicated intrigue.Luther receives a recording of the entire attack from an anonymous source.
